title: Mixed Event — Special Present for You! — Episode7 The Gift of a Show

meta.Episode: Episode7 — The Gift of a Show
meta.Event Outline: Rui has received a request to write and direct a ski resort's Christmas show. This is the first script he's penned in some time, and it's apparently based on a Christmas episode from his own childhood...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow... Look at how many guests have gathered!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The staff even said this is more people than they were initially expecting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Some apparently became interested in watching after we asked them about making lanterns with us.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Gotcha. I guess that ended up being a good way of advertising it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That means we were able to help!
Let's do our best when the moment comes!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your patience.
The Christmas show will begin momentarily!

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus B
rows.Line: “You seem to be training harder than usual today. But this is our big day, so be careful not to get injured, okay?”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line:
“Yes, I'm being careful.
But I can't seem to stay still. After all, it's Christmas Eve!”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Looks like it...
They're wearing red suits and hats, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: They all seem way too buff...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've never seen such burly Santa Clauses before...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, look...! The one on the right is a member of the Phoenix Stage cast!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You serious? How can you tell?
His beard and hat are covering up most of his face.

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “Those scoundrels are likely going to test us again this year by trying to prevent us from delivering our presents. But we shall overcome...!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line:
“Alright, we're set to take off.
Let's fly, my trusty reindeer!”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “Yes, I'll pull my hardest again this year!”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “And my red nose will light up the night sky...!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow, his nose is actually glowing!
That's really cute!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Tsukasa and Emu are playing the reindeer...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, that suits Tsukasa very well since carrying the presents is a very important job...

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “Alright, let's go deliver these to the children!”

rows.Speaker: Phantom Christmas Trees
rows.Line:
“Arrrgh! M-My branch...
The lights wrapped around it are so bright...!”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “I don't think any of us were expecting Christmas tree monsters to appear...!”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “But it seems that they're weak against flashing lights!”

rows.Speaker: Phantom Christmas Trees
rows.Line:
“Grr...!
How were you muscleheads able to wrap these around us so nimbly?”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “Heh. That's because the children are going to love seeing you all gussied up...”

rows.Speaker: Phantom Christmas Trees
rows.Line:
“For the children...
Alas, we must admit defeat...”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line:
“The trees are running...!
Way to go, you guys!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus B
rows.Line: “Yes, this is why we carry around lights for different kinds of trees.”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line:
“But many trials still lie ahead.
Stay frosty, my trusty reindeer!”

rows.Speaker: Phantom Snowman
rows.Line:
“You shall not pass...
Leave those presents and flee!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus B
rows.Line:
“These presents are for the children.
We are not about to let you have them.”

rows.Speaker: Phantom Snowman
rows.Line:
“Fine. Then, we will take them from you...
Pummel them with snowballs, everyone!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow, look at all the snowballs...!
This is so cool!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Kusanagi's backstage making all the snowballs. I know she's using that machine, but she's churning out a ton.

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “No... I can't move forward at all...”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line:
“Don't give up!
This is when you need to curl up your fists and...!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line:
“Yes, so we can't afford to fail here.
We must keep moving forward... For the children!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, to think that they could punch their way through that storm of snowballs...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (After the lights go out, the staff will guide the guests down the slope and light the lanterns.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We'll all need to work together in unison, but I'm sure...)

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line:
“Oh, I'm starting to see some lights!
We must be approaching the city!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line: “This is it, trusty reindeer! The home stretch!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus B
rows.Line:
“What's wrong? Why have you stopped?
Your nose has even gone out.”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line:
“Huh...?!
The city's lights just all went out...!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “Wh-What's going on?! We won't be able to see where all the houses are... That means it's going to be impossible to deliver these presents!”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line:
“You really are muscleheads!
It was so obvious that you wouldn't be able to find the children's houses if all the lights went out!”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “Hehehe... Delivering those presents is going to be impossible now. So, hand them over!”

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
The lights have gone out...
This is the signal to take our lanterns down.

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, please start making your way down the slope!

rows.Speaker: Staff Member
rows.Line:
Please form a single-file line.
Also, it's very dark, so please watch your step.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Despite having to make a drastic change, everyone's moving along like this was the original plan...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (People who make shows really are amazing...!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Okay, it looks like everybody is in position.
All that's left is to...)

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line:
“Hand over the presents already!
Honestly, what's the point of holding on to them?”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line: “It's not like they're going to reach their recipients now!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line:
“But... But!
We have to deliver these...!”

rows.Speaker: Reindeer
rows.Line:
“No! None of the lights should be working...
Who's behind this?!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line:
“Those are the locals...
They're using lanterns to indicate where their houses are!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line:
“Let's go!
We need to get these presents to the children!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line:
“Hah hah hah hah!
You'll never catch us! Not with those puny legs!”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus A
rows.Line: “The wait is over! And thank you all for your help! We have your presents right here!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow...!
It's really Santa Claus! This is amazing...

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “We can feel your collective desire to see us from all the way across the sky.”

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “So, thank you for believing in us.”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Wow...
They really heard our wishes...!

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Um, Santa...
Will we get to see you again?

rows.Speaker: Santa Claus C
rows.Line: “Yes, next year... I promise to return no matter what.”
